international.title: Joanne Young’s faith in justice system is sign of real change, but courts are still catching up
international.summary: Young’s abusers were convicted through suspect-centric prosecution, though much more needs to be done for victims Hope can be found in the darkest of places. Joanne Young stood outside Winchester crown court on Thursday and said she was relieved – not just for herself and her family – but for women in the future. Young, who was subjected to years of drugging and rape by her husband , who invited other men to assault her, waived her anonymity to speak out. Continue reading...
